October 19–24, 2022Los Angeles to CaboHistorical Event Archive

Event Story

The documented chapter.

Four days after the Huntington Beach recruitment event, the archive moves from a local Southern California milestone into a multi-day destination experience. Wild Ones and Bass Babes took part in Groove Cruise from Los Angeles to Cabo between October 19 and October 24, 2022.

The dedicated archive is structured to preserve the trip as more than a single gallery: cruise and destination photography, promotional artwork, confirmed artist connections, passes, merchandise and other memorabilia can all be cataloged as the historical material is assembled.
